body:
## Pull request overview

This PR adjusts the auto-generated column list in `RelatedList` so that the `id` field is excluded when deriving columns from an object schema. This aligns the component behavior with its existing unit test expectations and avoids rendering an “ID” column by default in related record tables.

**Changes:**
- Exclude the `id` field from schema-derived columns in `RelatedList` (in addition to excluding underscore-prefixed fields).
